title: LearnIT V6 shared media zoom R1
purpose: Implement one canonical full-screen 100–800% SVG/raster image viewer shared by the Activity Explorer and learner source, with fit, mouse wheel, drag, touch pinch, keyboard control, focus restore and bounded pan. Qualify only; do not publish.
requiredEvidence: Exact current main baseline, seven-file PR scope and independent GitHub CI checks
Real Chromium desktop and mobile/touch tests on unmodified canonical ES modules and CSS
Existing hints/browser activity regression tests unchanged
Deterministic standalone learner HTML candidate build twice, no root cutover
60 candidate routes versus exact baseline; 58 byte-identical and exactly two shared resources updated, saved evidence
adversarialTests: Reject scope expansion, additional publisher, private kit or session changes
Reject unsafe SVG/raster, over-800% zoom, unbounded pan, missing focus return
Reject incorrect modal teardown, pinch gestures or keyboard affordances
Reject any claim of published success from staging
nonGoals: No GitHub merge or Pages deployment under this GO
No alteration of Factory, kits, catalogue, permissions, progress data or existing root HTML
No new duplicate renderer or Pages publisher
No changes to progressive-hints domain authority
independentReview: Review accessibility and security of original shared media module
Verify exact browser tests and byte identity of 58 preserved published resources
Require fresh GO for release and actual HTTP verification
invariants: Current learner root unaffected until separately authorized cutover
Fail closed on uncertain scope or build

validation.style: single shared module and one stylesheet
